name: k11-workspace-write-safety
title: K11 workspace write safety and /undo
description: Confine fs_write_file/fs_edit_file/fs_file_operations mutations to WORKSPACE_ROOT (default cwd), deny protected paths (.git/.ssh/.env/*.pem etc), backup before mutation under .yaicli-backups (0600), add bounded in-memory undo + /undo REPL command; central stdlib guard in tools/workspace.py + execute_tool_call hook. No new deps; builtins stay standalone.
